text:
Predicates:
Roses(x) ::: x are roses.
GivenOutOnTV(x) ::: x are given out on TV.
OnMondayAt8PM(x) ::: x occur on some Mondays at 8 pm.
Bachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
PortraysRealPeople(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTVShow(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
BreakingBad ::: the show Breaking Bad.
Premises:
∀x (Roses(x) ∧ GivenOutOnTV(x) ∧ OnMondayAt8PM(x)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (GivenOutOnTV(x) → OnMondayAt8PM(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on some Monday at 8 pm.
∀x (GivenOutOnTV(x) → Bachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (Bachelor(x) → PortraysRealPeople(x)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (PortraysRealPeople(x) → RealityTVShow(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTVShow(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
OnMondayAt8PM(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is on Monday at 8 pm.
